precedence: state mismatch alone; otherwise all failed applicable guards, unique and sorted by ASCII name

refusals.name: checkpoint-state-mismatch
refusals.condition: Action has no constructor for the supplied State

refusals.name: rotation-evidence-invalid
refusals.condition: rotationTo at the recorded epoch and sequence returns false

refusals.name: sequence-not-later
refusals.condition: Requested sequence is less than or equal to the recorded sequence

refusals.name: intent-unauthorized
refusals.condition: intentOk returns false for the next epoch, action intent and refund option

refusals.name: quorum-missing
refusals.condition: poison quorum at the current epoch returns false

refusals.name: already-poisoned
refusals.condition: poison requires a clear poison flag

refusals.name: freeze-pool-covers-premium
refusals.condition: freeze pool is greater than or equal to P

refusals.name: already-frozen
refusals.condition: freeze requires a clear freeze flag

refusals.name: freeze-poisoned
refusals.condition: freeze requires a clear poison flag

refusals.name: duplicity-evidence-invalid
refusals.condition: duplicityAt at the recorded epoch and sequence returns false

refusals.name: registry-leaf-not-absent
refusals.condition: System register requires an absent leaf

refusals.name: registry-leaf-not-parked
refusals.condition: System reopen requires a parked leaf

refusals.name: deployment-operation-unsupported
refusals.condition: The bound deployment profile has no implementation of the selected Checkpoint transition semantics
